name: atlas-mcp
description: Ask your AI assistant about your organisation's Atlas model: capabilities, systems, owners, changes, decisions, goals and principles. Read-only.
long_description: Lets your assistant read your Atlas models: search and open elements, follow relationships, run saved reports, see health findings and the application portfolio, and look at proposed changes, decisions, projects, goals and principles. It is read-only, shows only what you can already see in Atlas, and signs in as you with your own Atlas email and password. Your organisation's owner must have turned on Ask Atlas.

email.title: Atlas email
email.description: The email you sign in to Atlas with.

password.title: Atlas password
password.description: Your Atlas password. Claude Desktop keeps it in your computer's secure storage.

check_for_updates.title: Check for updates
check_for_updates.description: Once each time it starts, fetch a small version file from Atlas to tell you when a newer version is available. Sends nothing about you or your models.
